 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Serbia hosts Germany today in the 2026-27 UEFA Nations League at Stadion Rajko Mitić in Belgrade.
 Germany enters the fixture after a disappointing start to their campaign having collected just five points from four matches and sit third in Group A2. Jürgen Klopp's side are three points behind leaders Netherlands and second-place Greece and desperately need a win to keep their quarterfinal hopes alive.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Serbia, meanwhile, are bottom of the group with zero points after losing all four of their matches. The Eagles have already been eliminated from the quarterfinal race but will still be looking to end their losing run today to avoid automatic relegation to League B. 
 The last time they met, Germany won 2-0 in October, thanks to goals from Tom Bischof and Florian Wirtz.
 The match is being played behind closed doors due to a UEFA disciplinary sanction against Serbia.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Serbia vs. Germany Team News
 Veljko Paunović will be without Sasa Lukić and Nemanja Maksimović, who are suspended for today's encounter. Aleksandar Stanković, Andrej Ilić, Strahinja Pavlović and Adem Avdić are also among the reported unavailable players due to injury.
 AUGSBURG, GERMANY – SEPTEMBER 27: Joshua Kimmich during the UEFA Nations League 2026/27 match between Germany and Greece.Alexander Hassenstein / Getty Images
 Serbia will also be without Paunović on the touchline due to a suspension.
 Jürgen Klopp too has several injury concerns heading into the fixture as Jamal Musiala, Serge Gnabry, Waldemar Anton, Assan Ouédraogo are all unavailable.

 Serbia expected lineup: 
 Goalkeeper: V Milinkovic-Savic
 Defenders: Nedeljkovic, Gudelj, Babic, Erakovic, Sukacev
 Midfielders: Samardzic, S Milinkovic-Savic, Zivkovic
 Forwards: Cvetkovic, Mitrovic
 Germany expected lineup: 
 Goalkeeper: Ter Stegen
 Defenders: Treu, Tah, Schlotterbeck, Brown

 Forwards: Havertz
